meta.title: The Bus Leaves at Half Past Eight
meta.textType: functional: a school announcement and a note from Mom

paragraphs: On Friday, November thirteenth, the members of the Explorers sat in the school hall for the morning announcement. The children sat on the floor in rows. Lily, Leo, Mia, and May sat in the front row. Teacher Kim stood at a microphone next to a big board. "Good morning, Explorers," she said. "Tomorrow, Saturday, we are going to the aquarium." "Please meet at the school gate at eight o'clock."

"The bus is leaving at half past eight, so please arrive early." "Please bring a hat, a bottle of water, and the signed form." "Do not forget your hat, because the sun is hot at midday." "It will be dry in the morning." "The aquarium is open all day, so we will have a lot of time." "If the bus is delayed, we will wait in the library." "I will call your parents, too." "Does everybody have the signed form?" asked Teacher Kim. Lily wrote a list in her notebook on her knee. It said, "hat, water, form." Leo moved close to Mia and whispered something funny. Mia smiled.

That evening, Lily came home and found a note on the fridge. A magnet held it up. "Lily, I signed your form." "Dad is taking you to the gate at a quarter to eight." "Please remember your hat and your water bottle." "Good luck, and have fun! Love, Mom." Lily put the form in her backpack. Then she put the hat and the water bottle on the table next to it.

At dinner, Lily asked Dad, "Would you wake me up at six o'clock?" "Of course," said Dad. "Is the form in your backpack?" "Yes, it is," said Lily. Lily looked at Tom. "Would you lend me your big water bottle?" she asked. "Of course," said Tom. "Mine is small, and the day will be hot." Tom took a blue bottle from the cupboard and filled it with cold water. Lily put it in her backpack and thanked him.

Lily went to bed soon after dinner, because the bus was leaving early. She looked at her backpack, her hat, and her water bottle once more. "Everything is ready," she said. "I think tomorrow will be a good day."
